Bug_Title: Locks should be released on all paths
Bug_Explanation: If a lock is acquired and released within a method, then it must be released along all execution paths of that method. Failing to do so will expose the conditional locking logic to the method's callers and hence be deadlock-prone.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by calling the `doSomething` method without first acquiring the lock. This is a violation of the rule 'Locks should be released on all paths'
